newsitem.title: USA: IFC to include Israel in emerging market indices.
newsitem.headline: IFC to include Israel in emerging market indices.

text.p: The International Finance Corp (IFC) said Sunday it will include Israel in its set of benchmark indices for emerging stock markets starting May 19.
The IFC said its Global Israel and Investable Israel indices will focus on the largest and most active stocks listed on the Tel-Aviv Stock Exchange.

The indices will have an estimated total capitalization of approximately $28 billion at current prices, before making standard adjustments to eliminate cross-ownership and government holdings from the index.
Israel's inclusion in the IFC composite indexes will be considered at the IFC's next index advisory panel meeting, the World Bank affiliate said in a statement.
The indices will have a base of December 31, 1996, and will be available daily. Details of their constituents will be released two weeks before launch.
Combined with indexes for Egypt, Jordan, Morocco and Tunisia, the Israel index will make regional Middle East indexes possible, IFC emerging markets index manager Robert Shakotko said.
